checks.instructions: Move the paddle left and right with the mouse, keyboard arrows and a mapped controller stick. Confirm the selected device actually reaches gameplay; scripted verification is separate evidence.
Use K to save, advance play, then L to restore the saved ball, paddle and cleared-band state. After a loss, use R to restart. Observe the actual native keys.
Keep the existing fixed 2D view. Resize the window and confirm the paddle, pink ball and six glass bands remain visible at their correct relative positions without introducing a perspective camera.
Check that Glass cleared N/6 stays readable above the teal/gold bands and agrees with bands removed during play. Inspect the real window at a small and a large size.

With sound enabled and a physical output selected, hear the existing paddle/band impact cue. Toggle M and confirm the sound setting works. No background music or new soundtrack is required. Muted capture/null PCM counters do not verify audibility.
